name: Associated Email Discovery and Review
description: Folds the addresses stored evidence already shows into evidence-linked candidates, lists them as confirmed, likely or possible, and routes every decision to a person.
legal_notes: Applies to verified self-audits and consent-based engagements. Results are leads, not facts; nothing is verified automatically. Every run re-checks the subject's authorization, and revoking it switches the schedule off.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: Discovery from GitHub and public pages needs an explicit run from the Associated emails screen (it contacts those sites); this workflow only reads what is already stored.
Steps marked as review are carried out by a person in the Target Profile screens; the automation does not perform them.
